title: The fake sneakers video
text: A TikTok creator with 1.8 million followers posted a video: sneakers bought on Aisle, she says, are fake. It is being shared widely; people are tagging Aisle under its Black Friday ads. Known: the order is real and came from a seller on Aisle. Not known: whether the sneakers are fake; how many sellers or products are involved.
source: dashboard, Company update week 3, published 24 Oct 14:00

title: Aisle's own check: the sneakers are fake
text: Aisle's own check: the sneakers in the video are fake and came from a small sneaker seller. Complaints since the video point to a few other sneaker and handbag sellers. Fewer than 20 sellers in total; all have been asked for invoices. Two other creators have shared the video.
source: dashboard, Company update week 4, published 24 Oct 14:30

title: Rapid Parcel drivers walk out
text: Contract talks at Rapid Parcel failed. Drivers walked out on Tuesday, December 1. Rapid Parcel is delivering with managers and temporary drivers and says its parcels will take "several extra days". It cannot say for how long.
source: dashboard, Known crisis week 5, published 24 Oct 15:00

title: Government shutdown
text: Overnight, Congress missed its funding deadline, and parts of the federal government shut down. Some federal workers have been sent home; others, such as air traffic controllers and TSA officers, must keep working without pay. Nobody knows how long it will last. Known: Social Security payments and the Postal Service continue. Not known: how long it will last; when federal workers will be paid; which services will slow down. Federal workers and contractors are a small share of Aisle's buyers, larger around Washington, D.C. Some sellers were waiting for Small Business Administration loans, which are now paused.
source: dashboard, Government shutdown, week 7, published 24 Oct 16:00

title: Government shutdown — update
text: The Senate passed a short-term funding bill; the House plans to vote after Christmas. Federal workers have been told they will get back pay once the government reopens. Their December 30 paycheck may be missed.
source: dashboard, Government shutdown — update, week 8, published 24 Oct 16:30
